title: First public protest near the construction site
summary: The movement records a protest near the coastal construction area as the first event in its chronology.
source_status: Movement chronology; event linked to outside reporting

title: Gathering at Narta Lagoon
summary: Residents and activists gathered against development in the protected wetland landscape.
source_status: Movement chronology; event linked to outside reporting

title: Zvërnec confrontation becomes a catalyst
summary: Video circulated of private security dragging a protester near a fenced coastal area. The incident helped drive wider mobilization.
source_status: Independent reporting; conduct described from published footage and reports

title: Protests move to Tirana
summary: A march went from the police directorate to the Interior Ministry and prime minister's office. Nightly demonstrations followed.
source_status: Movement chronology; daily protests corroborated by outside reporting

title: Protests spread across Albania and abroad
summary: The movement records simultaneous action in eight Albanian cities and the beginning of diaspora gatherings.
source_status: Movement account; scale requires independent confirmation

title: Large Tirana march and regional environmental action
summary: A major march took place in central Tirana while residents in Rrjoll protested another development in a protected area.

title: March toward the airport
summary: Protesters marched along the highway in the direction of Tirana International Airport.
source_status: Movement chronology linked to Euronews Albania

title: Major rally with diaspora participation
summary: A large weekend rally drew Albanians living abroad, including people who travelled in convoys from several European countries.
source_status: Independent reporting; exact crowd size not independently established

title: Tensions and clashes around institutions
summary: Separate actions at the Polytechnic University, parliament and SPAK were followed by detentions, injuries and clashes. Accounts differ and individual incidents require review.
source_status: Media chronology; allegations and figures remain attributed

title: Thirty-fifth consecutive night
summary: A large march called for the government's resignation, constitutional reform and action against corruption. Police used a water cannon after windows at a police station were broken.
source_status: Independent reporting; crowd size not independently verified

title: Daily protests during parliament's final session
summary: The movement records daily demonstrations during the closing weeks of the parliamentary session.

title: Sixty days of daily civic action
summary: Citizens.al described two months of marches, artistic installations, projected messages and other symbolic actions.

title: Diaspora returns to Tirana
summary: Albanians living abroad joined three consecutive days of protest in the capital.

title: Digital protest map documents a wider network
summary: Citizens.al reported that the volunteer-built map listed activity across 84 cities and 325 protest-days. These were platform totals rather than independently audited counts.

title: One hundred days and Berlin diaspora action
summary: Citizens.al marked 100 days of protest and profiled diaspora participation around a planned gathering outside the Albanian Embassy in Berlin.
source_status: Independent local reporting; Berlin event described as planned

title: Clashes as parliament resumes
summary: Protesters challenged a police cordon near parliament; objects were thrown and police detained demonstrators after the movement passed its 100th day.

title: Four months of nightly demonstrations
summary: ORF reported that nightly protests were continuing and described the environmental dispute as the spark for broader anti-corruption concerns.

title: Student-led protests and reported confrontations
summary: Student demonstrations focused on education and wider governance concerns. Reporting documented injuries, detentions, damage and alleged violations requiring impartial investigation.
source_status: Public-source synthesis; claims separated by verification status
